annotations.text:
Colour: one azure hue. Grey = unselected, azure = selected (pale fill + azure border + dark-azure label), red is reserved for critical conditions only (the "Breached" chip, and the "Inaccessible" road state).

How each answer reaches the reasoner (Prolog rules stay unchanged):

Embankment — Holding / At risk / Unknown all map to intact for the severe-override; "At risk"/"Unknown" add a note on the result. Only "Breached" forces Severe.
Rainfall — "No rain" and "Unknown" behave like Light (no severity floor, 0 priority points).
Upstream — 24h→1 day, 48h→2, 72h+→3 (the +4 priority bonus fires at 72h+). Unknown→0.
Landform — all map to low_lying except "Other" → elevated + note.
Road — Accessible→open, Inaccessible→impassable, Limited/Unknown→open + note.
Groups — any box ticked = vulnerable_present true (+7 priority). Detail kept on the record.
Injured — Unknown does NOT reserve a medic; it's flagged for the coordinator.
Range — sends 50 / 300 / 1,000 / 5,000 / 20,000; boundaries at 100/500/2,000/10,000 are what move the score.

Every Unknown / mapped value collects into an "Assumptions made" panel on the Results screen.
